items.raw_excerpt: Influenza cases are peaking unusually late in the year in Australia, so if you haven't had your flu jab this season, it's actually not too late.
items.summary_en: Flu cases in Australia are peaking later than usual this year. Health officials say it is still not too late to get a free flu shot if you have not had one yet this season.

items.raw_excerpt: The company has been beset by financial difficulties since the Covid pandemic, and 2026 marks the seventh successive year that Tivoli will report a loss.
items.summary_en: Tivoli, a travelling funfair in Finland, will close for good. The fair moved from park to park every summer for 138 years. It has lost money every year since the Covid pandemic, and 2026 is the seventh year of losses.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드의 이동식 놀이공원 티볼리가 138년 만에 완전히 문을 닫는다. 이 공원은 여름마다 장소를 옮겨 다녔지만, 코로나 이후 계속 손해를 봤고 2026년에도 일곱 해 연속 영업 손실을 기록하게 됐다.
items.title_en: Finland's travelling funfair Tivoli closes after 138 years

items.raw_excerpt: Most of Taiwan will see cloudy to sunny skies over the Mid-Autumn Festival long weekend, with consistently hot temperatures expected to last well into next week, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) forecast Friday.
items.summary_en: Most of Taiwan will have cloudy to sunny skies during the Mid-Autumn Festival long weekend. The Central Weather Administration says hot temperatures will stay well into next week.

items.raw_excerpt: Nene Royal will rock Singapore next month when the Thai sensation opens for Avenged Sevenfold.
items.summary_en: Nene Royal, a Thai singer, will perform in Singapore next month. She will open the show before the American rock band Avenged Sevenfold. She became known after winning America's Got Talent.
items.summary_ko: 태국 가수 네네 로얄이 다음 달 싱가포르에서 공연한다. 미국 록 밴드 어벤지드 세븐폴드의 공연에 앞서 무대로 오른다. 그는 America's Got Talent 우승자로 알려진 가수다.

items.raw_excerpt: Public health centers in Seoul have been reposting the same doctor vacancies for more than six months without success, as public salaries fall far behind those at private hospitals and clinics.
items.summary_en: Seoul's public health centers have reposted the same doctor vacancies for more than six months. No one has applied to the jobs. Public clinics pay much less than private hospitals, so doctors keep choosing private work.
items.summary_ko: 서울시 공공 보건기관이 같은 의사 채용 공고를 6개월 넘게 반복해서 올렸습니다. 하지만 지원자는 한 명도 나오지 않았습니다. 공공 의료기관의 급여가 사립 병원보다 훨씬 낮아 의사가 사ório를 택하기 때문입니다.
items.title_en: Seoul public clinics post doctor jobs, still nobody applies

items.title_original: Six job ads, zero applicants: South Korea's capital can't find doctors for its public clinics

items.raw_excerpt: El zurdo se verá las caras ante el experimentado francés Adrian Mannarino.
items.summary_en: Chilean tennis player Alejandro Tabilo will play his first match at the ATP tournament in Chengdu, China. His first opponent is the French player Adrian Mannarino, who has much more experience on the main tour. The match is set for this week in Chengdu.

items.title_en: Tabilo Plays His First Match in Chengdu
items.title_ko: 타비로, 청두에서 첫 경기

items.raw_excerpt: Bengaluru Solid Waste Management Limited is hoping to establish strict accountability through close monitoring of the collection system.
items.summary_en: Bengaluru wants to change the way it collects garbage. Out of 21 companies that won the new work orders, only six said yes. The city agency says it will watch the collection work closely and make the companies answer for their work.
items.summary_ko: 벵가루루시는 쓰레기를 모으는 방식을 새롭게 바꾸려 한다. 새 작업 지시를 받은 21개 업체 가운데 6곳만 수락한 상황이다. 도시는 수거 과정을 꼼꼼히 살피면서 업체에 책임을 지도록 단단한 방법을 세우겠다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Bengaluru garbage plan hits a snag as only 6 of 21 firms say yes
items.title_ko: 벵가루루 쓰레기 수거 개편, 21개 업체 중 6곳만 수주
items.title_original: Garbage collection revamp in Bengaluru faces hurdle as only six of 21 successful bidders accept work orders

items.raw_excerpt: A temporary vaccination service has been set up for a school community in Adelaide's southern suburbs after four students tested positive for measles.
items.summary_en: Four students from a school community in the southern suburbs of Adelaide tested positive for measles. Health officials set up a temporary vaccination service for local families. The clinic is meant to stop the outbreak from spreading further.
items.summary_ko: 애들레이드 남부 학교 지역에서 학생 4명이 사마포스 감염으로 확인됐다. 당국은 주변 가족을 위해 예방접종 임시 진료소를 문을 열었다. 추가 확산을 막기 위한 조치다.
items.title_en: Vaccine clinic opens after four teens catch measles

items.raw_excerpt: High risk of Russian sabotage, rare leopard cub born in Copenhagen's Zoo and more news from Denmark on Friday.
items.summary_en: A rare leopard cub was born at Copenhagen Zoo in Denmark. Officials say the cub is doing well. The roundup also reports a high risk of Russian sabotage and other news from Denmark.

items.raw_excerpt: Mario Panteli, who lives near a Thornton-Cleveleys chemical plant, says he is shocked by the "bombshell".
items.summary_en: A father who lives near a chemical plant in Thornton-Cleveleys says he was shocked to find forever chemicals in his blood. He calls the test result a bombshell and says he fears for his family's health. The plant sits close to local homes and schools.
items.summary_ko: 썬튼-클리브스의 화학공장 근처에 사는 마리오 판텔리 아버리가 자기 혈액에서 영구 화학물질이 발견됐다며 크게 놀랐다고 말했다. 그는 이 검사 결과를 정체를 알 수 없는 충격으로 받아들이며 가족의 건강이 걱정된다고 말했다. 이 공장은 주변 주택과 학교에 가까이 자리 잡고 있다.
items.title_en: Dad finds forever chemicals in his blood
items.title_ko: 혈액에서 영구 화학물질 검출된 아버지, 가족 건강 걱정

items.raw_excerpt: Ritchie Wood is almost brought to tears at he looks at the empty homes once loved by his neighbours.
items.summary_en: Ritchie Wood is close to tears when he looks at the empty homes his neighbours once loved. A huge £5bn theme park plan in Windsor, England, pushed him and other residents out of their houses.
items.summary_ko: 리치 우드는 이웃들이 사랑했던 텅 빈 집들을 바라보자니 눈물이 나올 뻔한다. 영국 윈저에 추진된 50억 파운드 규모의 테마파크 때문에 그는 다른 주민들과 함께 집을 떠나야 했다.

items.raw_excerpt: Gibbons at Christchurch's Orana Wildlife Park have been treated to smears of Marmite and peanut butter on poles, and gift-wrapped boxes of cooked corn and live locusts, as part of the zoo's 50th birthday celebrations.
items.summary_en: Gibbons at Orana Wildlife Park in Christchurch got special treats for the zoo's 50th birthday. The animals were given smears of Marmite and peanut butter on poles, plus gift-wrapped boxes of cooked corn and live locusts. Zookeepers said the odd snacks were part of the celebration.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 크라이치히치의 오라나 야생동물공원이 50주년을 맞았다. 원숭이들에게 기둥에 마라이트와 땅콩버터를 바르고, 포장된 찐옥수수와 살아 있는 메뚜기가 담긴 상자를 선물했다. 사육사들은 이 이상한 간식이 축하 행사의 일부였다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Marmite smears and live locusts for Orana Wildlife Park's 50th birthday
items.title_ko: 마라이트 발라 주고 살아 있는 메뚜기, 오라나 야생동물공원 50주년
items.title_original: Marmite smears, live locusts to celebrate Orana Wildlife Park's 50th birthday

items.raw_excerpt: Follow The Hindu's LIVE for the latest updates on Ganesh Visarjan in Hyderabad as the famous Khairatabad Ganesh idol is taken out for immersion amid a large turnout of devotees.
items.summary_en: A giant laddu from the Balapur Ganesh idol sold for a record 39 lakh rupees at auction in Hyderabad. The idol is now being taken to the water for immersion. Crowds are large and traffic is restricted in central Hyderabad until September 26.

items.summary_en: Some students in Ireland spend up to four hours a day traveling to and from college. Long commutes hurt their sleep, schoolwork and social life. They say the housing shortage is the cause.

items.summary_en: A list looks at ten German cities that are good places for foreigners to retire. It says mid-sized cities offer culture and city life, while small towns give peace and quiet.

items.summary_en: More than 7,000 people gathered at Chichen Itza in Mexico for the fall equinox. They waited through heavy clouds to watch the famous snake shadow slide down the temple stairs.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코 치친 잇자에서 7천 명이 넘는 사람이 가을 분점에 모였다. 이들은 구름이 덮인 하늘을 뚫고 기다려 피라미드 계단을 내려가는 유명한 뱀 그림자를 보았다.

items.raw_excerpt: "Força, Equilibri, Valor i Seny" – strength, balance, courage and mindfulness - is the motto of Catalonia's most famous and spectacular cultural tradition.
items.summary_en: Els castells are human towers built in Catalonia, Spain. People climb on each other's shoulders to build towers up to ten levels high. Teams work together to stay balanced and raise a small flag at the top.
items.summary_ko: 엘스 카스텔스는 스페인 카탈루냐 지역에서 만들어지는 인간 탑이다. 사람들이 서로의 어깨에 올라 10층까지 높이 쌓는다. 팀이 함께 균형을 잡고 꼭대기에 작은 깃발을 올린다.
items.title_en: Catalonia's Human Towers: Strength, Balance and Teamwork
items.title_ko: 카탈루냐의 인간 탑, 힘과 균형과 teamwork의 예술
